allow: PowerShell(foreach \($c in 'py','python3','node','npm','pwsh'\) { $p = \(Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\); if \($p\) { "$c -> $\($p.Source\)" } else { "$c -> MISSING" } })

PowerShell($t = Get-Content 'thai-phrasebook.html' -Raw -Encoding UTF8; "len=$\($t.Length\)"; foreach \($k in 'IPA','ipa','katakana','カタカナ','speechSynthesis','audio','button','phrase-card'\) { "$k : " + \([regex]::Matches\($t,[regex]::Escape\($k\)\)\).Count })
